title: Crispy Chicken Confit Wings with Lemon
description: A twist on traditional confit, these crispy chicken wings are marinated in a mixture of herbs and spices, then baked until caramelized and finished with a squeeze of lemon.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken wings to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the chicken wings in a single layer.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the wings are cooked through and caramelized.
Remove the wings from the oven and toss with confit until well coated.
Return the wings to the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes or until the confit is caramelized and sticky.
Remove the wings from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
